description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

True Anomaly is hiring an early-career Software QA Engineer for a temporary engagement with potential conversion to regular employment. The role focuses on executing manual and automated tests, documenting defects, collaborating with developers and product teams, and improving QA processes.
Software Engineer I, QA testing full-stack software with manual and Playwright automation, documenting defects in Jira

Responsibilities:
• Execute manual and automated test cases against a full stack software
• Document and report software defects within the software lifecycle in Jira
• Participate in an agile team sprint planning/stand ups
• Collaborate with developers and product teams to clarify requirements and reproduce issues
• Assist in maintaining a growing test repository of manual and automated scripts within Playwright framework
• Continuous contribution to QA standards and testing processes

Requirements:
• Bachelors degree in computer science or related field/equivalent education
• 0-2 years experience in software qa/testing (internships included)
• General understanding of software development lifecycle, testing methodologies and Agile processes
• Basic understanding of coding languages
• Familiarity with Jira ticketing and Git
• Strong attention to detail and problem solving
• Strong communication skills
• U.S. Citizen and eligible for DoD Secret or TS/SCI clearance
• you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State

Preferred:
• preferred java script
• Exposure to automation tooling (playwright/cypress/selenium)
• Experience with API tooling
• Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (github actions/ jenkins, etc.)
• Motivated to learn and grow within QA industry
• Team player with a proactive, problem-solving mindset
• Ability to manage time and tasks effectively in a fast paced environment
• Flexible mindset
